outcome: composite adverse outcome (operative delivery/cesarean section for suspected fetal distress, intrauterine death, Apgar score <7 at 5 min, arterial pH <7.1, base excess of >-11 mEq/mL, or neonatal intensive care unit admission)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies complicated by late fetal growth restriction (FGR), as defined by Delphi consensus criteria
finding: CPR and UCR, measured one week prior to delivery, showed poor predictive value for adverse intrapartum and perinatal outcomes in pregnancies with late FGR.
